description: For every language \(L\), the matrix theory \(T_\Gamma\) is satisfiable exactly when all ground readings of its translation into the fixed language \(L(d)\) have one propositional satisfying valuation.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.fresh_constant_herbrand.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  (Γ : Set (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.Matrix L)) :
  (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.universalTheory Γ).IsSatisfiable ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.TheorySatisfiable
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.groundTheory
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.mapMatrix
            (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.freshInclusion L) ''
          Γ))
